issues.title: Y fabric band boost overshoots: tick and fleck now too contrasty (and fleck too saturated) at row distance
issues.detail: Fabric: tick weave / petal fleck / mix
issues.evidence: q15 x0.62 tick bright 0.15 vs 0.083, p90/p50 1.60 vs 1.47; fleck bright 0.20 vs 0.154, p90/p50 1.87 vs 1.76, B/R 3.0 vs 2.54, blob p90 6-7 vs 5 px; q16 row 2 tick bright 0.19 vs 0.064. w19 undershot by about the same amount; the right value is about halfway.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py econ section: scale the 0.5-2.5 cm band boost to ~0.5x its w20 gain on tick and fleck (keep the straightened 0.29 m tick crop, floor 0.05 and column lift); fleck: core colour toward #b8c3e2 (B/R <= 1.5) and ~25 % fewer flecks; re-cut tex_y_tick / tex_y_fleck. Targets at q15 x0.62: tick bright 0.08-0.10, p90/p50 1.46-1.52, p10/p50 0.48-0.52; fleck bright 0.15-0.165, p90/p50 1.74-1.80, B/R 2.45-2.65.

issues.title: Headrest cover: flatter plate at r 0.38 mirrors the ceiling - middle covers grey and light head-on (regressed); close/oblique still near-black
issues.fix: 09_seats.js SEATMAT yCover r 0.38 -> 0.48 (one line, shared) and 09a_econ.js restore the plate bow to ~3 mm so the highlight stays a narrow band; targets q15 c2/c3 L50 <= 58 with B/R >= 1.65, c1/c4 >= 50. The grazing lift (e4 >= 75, q16 row 2 >= 75) needs a Fresnel / sheen term from the lighting owner, not lower roughness - hand off rather than iterate r again (see the w5-w20 oscillation in the SEATMAT comment).

issues.title: C armrest lower element is a thin round tube; aisle-end seats need a deep flat-sided lower panel
issues.evidence: b_ss_18 lower panel 1.75x the arm depth (~11-12 cm) with a flat side face, rounded front, bottom covering the pan frame; render 0.9x (5.6 cm tube at y 0.528 + sphere nose). y_47301 near aisle ends show broad white panels; q16 now shows rods. Middle arms: a slimmer element is acceptable (not visible in the photos).
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js econUnit regular-row branch: for k === 0 || k === arms.length - 1 replace the straight run of the ct tube with a loftAt panel, sections SEC(y_centre, depth, width 0.025, z, r 0.01): z -0.12 -> -0.40 at y 0.44-0.50 top 0.50, depth 0.12 at the rear tapering to 0.10 at the front with the bottom edge rising ~3 cm over the last 8 cm, front end rounded r 0.045, outer face flush with the arm side (x offset o * 0.012); keep the rear sweep tube into it. Middle arms: keep the tube but drop it to y 0.51 and flatten to x0.55 so it reads as a moulding.
